messages.content: Write a job posting for a senior backend engineer at a mid-sized fintech company. Around 250 words.

Senior Backend Engineer

We're a mid-sized fintech company building the infrastructure that moves money for small businesses. Our platform processes payments, reconciles accounts, and settles funds across banking partners — and it needs to work correctly every time, because our customers' payroll depends on it.

We're looking for a senior backend engineer to join our core platform team. You'll design and own services that handle transaction processing, ledger accuracy, and integrations with banking and card networks. You'll work closely with product and compliance to ship features that hold up under audit and under load.

What you'll do:
- Design and build backend services in a distributed, event-driven system (we run Go and Python on AWS)
- Own data integrity for money-movement flows, including idempotency, reconciliation, and failure recovery
- Review architecture decisions with peers and mentor engineers earlier in their careers
- Partner with compliance and risk teams on controls for a regulated environment
- Debug production issues where the cost of a bug is a wrong balance, not a broken button

What we're looking for:
- 5+ years building backend systems in production, ideally with financial or transactional data
- Strong grasp of database design, concurrency, and distributed systems tradeoffs
- Experience with at least one statically typed language (Go, Java, or similar)
- Comfort with ambiguity — we're still figuring out parts of this business
- Bonus: experience with payment rails, ACH, or card processing

We offer competitive salary, equity, full health coverage, and a remote-friendly culture with quarterly in-person team weeks. Based in the US; sponsorship not currently available.

To apply, send your resume and a short note on the most interesting technical problem you've solved to careers@[company].com.
